source.locator: docs/features/agent-practices-pack.md, rule 17; interpretation/provenance and evidence ledger; reviewed 2026-10-07
source.paraphrase: Before implementing nontrivial behavior, define its observable acceptance cases and expected failures; use those cases to guide the implementation rather than deriving expectations from the finished code, without forbidding later tests that close a real gap.

invariants.why: Before implementing nontrivial behavior, define its observable acceptance cases and expected failures; use those cases to guide the implementation rather than deriving expectations from the finished code, without forbidding later tests that close a real gap.
invariants.fixHint: Bind PRACTICE-017 to a human-reviewed product assertion with scope, applicability, owner, evidence source and freshness controls in its rationale. Include a failing control. Run pregate fitness run PRACTICE-017; repair failed assertions. Review conditional applicability instead of returning an unexplained pass.
invariants.avoid: This is a project evidence gate, not a syntax detector or readiness certification. A receipt proves only the reviewed assertion ran on the current inputs. External legal, certification, deployment and performance evidence needs its own authenticity, scope and freshness checks inside that assertion. Missing evidence remains unverified. Pack fixtures test receipt admission, not the product requirement. Packs never supply executable commands.
